core_obligations: Show the blowing up is an object of the subcategory (proof lines 8442-8443).
Build the map of graded algebras from the surjection f^*I -> I_D (proof lines 8443-8456).
Obtain the morphism Y -> X' over X (proof lines 8453-8456).
Prove uniqueness through the dense open complement of D (proof lines 8456-8466).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a closed subscheme Z of a scheme X, the blowing up X' -> X is a final object of the full subcategory of (Sch/X) consisting of those Y -> X whose inverse image of Z is an effective Cartier divisor (source lines 8433-8440). The proof first shows the blowing up itself lies in the subcategory, then takes f : Y -> X in it, uses that f^*I -> I_D is a surjection onto an invertible module to build a map of graded algebras bigoplus f^*I^d -> bigoplus I_D^d, invokes the relative Proj material to obtain a morphism Y -> X' over X, and proves uniqueness by restricting to the scheme theoretically dense open Y \ D and applying equality of morphisms into the separated X'.
